people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it. It is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he will be saved out of it.
translations.bsb: How awful that day will be! None will be like it! It is the time of Jacob’s distress, but he will be saved out of it.
translations.kjv: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob's trouble; but he shall be saved
